task.ques: Identify the latest top-trending open-source project in the topic of 'Machine Learning' on GitHub, and check the number of stars it has received.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Tesseract (tesseract-ocr/tesseract) is the best supported Machine Learning topic candidate: 77,212 total stars and 26 stars today, checked October 28, 2026.
Tesseract is explicitly tagged machine-learning and is Apache-2.0 licensed. It appears at #11 in GitHub’s C++ Trending list for Today, ahead of TensorFlow (#15), and is the highest-ranked machine-learning-tagged project verified in that list.
Scope: GitHub offers no Machine Learning topic-specific Trending filter. This establishes a currently trending project in the topic and its C++ rank, rather than a #1 ranking across all Machine Learning projects.
Evidence: https://github.com/topics/machine-learning and https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract (topic and license); https://github.com/trending/c++?since=daily (Today, C++, rank, total stars and stars today). Screenshot: final.png.
